caveats.statement: Some cards have no power value (NULL) or use '*' for power, which can break numeric comparisons.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*';

caveats.statement: Some cards have no content warning flag set to 0, which may be confused with NULL.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE hasContentWarning = 0;

caveats.statement: Some sets have no MTGO code (NULL), so they are not available on Magic: The Gathering Online.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE mtgoCode IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some sets have no block (NULL), so block-based filtering may miss them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE block IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some cards have no EDHRec rank (NULL), so ranking queries may exclude them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE edhrecRank IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some cards have no artist (NULL), so artist-based filtering may miss them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE artist IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some legalities rows have status 'Banned' but the format may not be present for all cards.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned';
